headline: Prince William And Princess Catherine Arrive In Mumbai For Earthshot
seoTitle: Prince William and Catherine Arrive in Mumbai
metaDescription: Prince William and Princess Catherine have arrived in Mumbai for a three-day India visit, featuring the Earthshot Prize awards ceremony.
aiSummaryBullets: Prince William and Princess Catherine have begun a three-day official visit to India starting in Mumbai.
The couple is scheduled to attend the sixth annual Earthshot Prize ceremony, which recognizes climate change innovation.
The itinerary includes cultural activities and a planned meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Delhi.
aiContextParagraph: The Prince and Princess of Wales have commenced a three-day visit to India, marking their first joint overseas tour since 2022. Upon their arrival in Mumbai, the royal couple was greeted with a series of public events, including a match of gully cricket and meetings with notable local figures. A central focus of their trip is the sixth Earthshot Prize, an environmental initiative founded by Prince William to support global climate change solutions, which is set to be awarded in Mumbai on November 17, 2026. Beyond the awards ceremony, the visit includes plans for the couple to travel to Delhi to meet with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. To accommodate the high-profile visit, local authorities in Mumbai have implemented various security measures, including road closures and traffic diversions throughout the city from November 16 to 19.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained significant media attention due to the high-profile nature of the royal visit and the upcoming Earthshot Prize awards ceremony in Mumbai.
